request.subject: UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER

layers.text: Add only a pattern on the hide: six very thick dark navy tiger stripes, colour #16203f: four down the back and flank and two across the tail. Each stripe is a fat solid wedge at least four pixels wide, with plain hide between them; no thin lines. The head, belly and legs stay plain. Do not redraw anything. Keep the amber-orange crest, the cream belly, the eyes, teeth, claws, pose, proportions, black outline and style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
